controller.name: DLS IK
controller.reads: the measured joint angles, every 50 ms tick
controller.given: the true geometry: forward kinematics and the Jacobian
controller.internal_model: none: every step is recomputed from the measured state (reactive)
controller.rule: damped least squares, lambda = 0.1; whole step scaled to the caps; joints at a limit left out

scoring.time_from: stored time course (every 4 ticks) and the last sample
